title: Assessing Wnt-reactivity of cytonemes in mouse embryonic stem cells
author: Junyent, Reeves, et al.
materials: Corning 96-well Clear Bottom Black Polystyrene Microplates

steps.title: Prepare JetPrime transfection mix
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube combine 500 µL JetPrime Buffer, 5 µg GCaMP6s or Ftractin‑mRuby3 plasmid, 3.2 µg psPAX2 plasmid, and 1.6 µg PMD2.G plasmid; vortex for 2 s, add 20 µL JetPrime reagent, vortex vigorously for 10 s, incubate the mixture still at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Transfect HEK293T cells and produce lentivirus
steps.instruction: Add the transfection mix dropwise to a plate of low‑passage HEK293T cells (cultured 3 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂), gently agitate the plate in a cross‑like pattern to distribute homogeneously, then incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; after 24 h aspirate media, rinse once with PBS, add 7 mL fresh media and incubate another 24 h; repeat media change and incubation two more times, collecting the supernatant each time, and keep plates at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ throughout.

steps.title: Harvest and concentrate lentiviral supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the three 24‑h media harvests into a 50 mL Falcon tube, pool them, filter through a 0.45 µm filter, add 4.6 mL Lenti‑X concentrator to 14 mL filtered supernatant (1:3 ratio), mix thoroughly and incubate at 4 °C overnight (12–20 h); centrifuge at 1.5 × 10³ rcf for 45 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant without disturbing the pellet, resuspend pellet in 2 mL ESC basal media, aliquot 250 µL portions for a 6‑well plate, use immediately or store at –80 °C (up to 2 years).

steps.title: Transduce ESCs with lentivirus
steps.instruction: Seed ESCs to reach sub‑confluent colonies (~3 days after seeding). On the day of transduction aspirate existing media, add 2 mL pre‑warmed ESC complete media and incubate >1 h; thaw a vial of GCaMP6s or Ftractin‑mRuby3 lentivirus at room temperature and add the virus dropwise to the ESC well (optimize virus volume as needed), then incubate 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. After incubation cells should retain normal ESC morphology.

steps.title: Purify transduced ESCs by FACS
steps.instruction: Prepare a single‑cell suspension of the transduced ESCs, resuspend cells in 250 µL FACS buffer (3 % FBS in PBS) with or without DAPI (0.5 µg/mL); sort DAPI‑negative, GFP‑positive (GCaMP6s) or mRuby3‑positive cells using a FACS instrument into a tube containing 3 mL ESC complete media; seed sorted cells into 6‑well plates and culture as previously described, verifying fluorescence expression by inverted microscopy; perform a second sort if needed to obtain a homogeneous population.

steps.title: Activate Dynabead surface with EDC/NHS
steps.instruction: Resuspend 30 µg Dynabeads in 25 mM MES buffer (pH 5), add 50 mg/mL EDC and 50 mg/mL NHS (both in MES buffer), and incubate 30 min at room temperature with slow rotation (30 rpm); immobilize beads with a magnet for 1 min when transferring or washing.

steps.title: Immobilize Wnt3a on Dynabeads
steps.instruction: Wash functionalized beads three times in MES buffer (5 min each), then incubate with 20 µL recombinant Wnt3a (40 µg/mL stock) mixed with 5× volume of MES buffer for 1 h at room temperature with slow rotation; for control beads use an equivalent concentration of the desired protein; after incubation wash beads three times in PBS (5 min each) and resuspend in 300 µL ESC basal media for quenching; optionally generate inactivated Wnt3a beads by resuspending pelleted beads in 20 mM DTT, incubating 45 min at 37 °C, then following the wash step; store all beads at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Assay Wnt3a‑bead activity with LSL cells
steps.instruction: Seed 5 × 10⁴ LSL reporter cells in 100 µL media per well of a 96‑well plate (triplicate) and incubate 4–6 h for attachment; add an additional 100 µL media, then add 2 µg Wnt3a‑beads or inactivated beads and 200 ng/mL soluble Wnt3a (or equivalent control); before addition triturate the bead stock >100 times by pipetting up/down, preferably mixing the stock, adding to 1.5 mL tube with 100 µL LSL media, mixing again, then adding to cells; incubate overnight (>16 h) at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; lyse cells with passive lysis buffer, measure luciferase activity using the Dual‑Light System assay on a Glomax‑Multi detector; successful beads give ≥100‑fold increase over negative control.
